scope: Text-based IP risk screening. No claim of image inspection, authenticity verification or complete brand coverage. Conditional rules require human evidence review.

decisions.reason: The text describes counterfeit or knockoff goods. Counterfeit goods cannot be listed, even when disclosed. Inspect the exact matched product before ending any existing listing.
